sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (10 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) confirm that an HA epitope-tagged PLPP2 (PAP-2c) construct was expressed in HEK293 and Sf9 cells and produced functional, membrane-associated PAP activity (L1). L2 further notes that HA-tagged PAP-2c did not display surface-accessible enzymatic activity in intact insect cells, consistent with the active site being oriented toward the lumen/cytoplasm rather than the extracellular face. However, neither L1 nor L2 states WHERE the HA tag was inserted — no residue number, no loop name, no terminus is specified. PLPP2 has no extracellular terminus (N-terminus residues 1–7 are intracellular; C-terminus residues 244–288 are intracellular), so the topology_derived path (exactly one extracellular terminus) is also unavailable. The tag could reside in any of the three extracellular loops (29–54, 121–170, 213–224) or at an intracellular terminus; there is no basis to pin it. This matches the explicit disqualifying criterion: 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue.' No other ledger lines exist. Zero sites qualify.
